templates.name: Morning Briefing
templates.description: Start the day with a summary of system health, pending tasks, and overnight activity.
templates.message:
Good morning. Give me a brief system status update:
1. Check system health (any errors overnight?)
2. Pending tasks or items needing attention
3. Scheduled content for today
4. Any budget alerts
Keep it concise — this is a daily briefing, not a deep dive.

templates.name: Nightly Summary
templates.description: End-of-day report covering what was accomplished, content published, and system health.
templates.message:
End of day summary. Report on:
1. Content published today (videos, posts)
2. Knowledge base changes
3. Any errors or failures
4. Today's API spend
5. Tomorrow's scheduled activity
Post the summary to the configured notification channel.

templates.name: Daily Video Topics
templates.description: Generate 2 video topics based on your content pillars. Rotates through pillars automatically.
templates.message:
Read the content pillars from /opt/AIWH/client/config/content-pillars.json.
Calculate today's pillar rotation based on the epoch date and rotation schedule.
Generate 2 video topics — one for each pillar slot today.
For each topic, provide:
- Title (compelling, under 60 chars)
- Hook (first 3 seconds — must stop the scroll)
- Pillar ID it belongs to
- Brief outline (3-4 key points)
Save to the daily content queue.

templates.name: Morning Video Script
templates.description: Write a 130-160 word video script for the morning content slot.
templates.message:
Write a short-form video script (130-160 words) for the first content slot today.
Read the topic from the daily content queue (pillar slot 1).
Read the client profile from your system prompt for voice and niche context.

The script must:
- Open with a hook (first 3 seconds must stop the scroll)
- Be written in the client's voice and niche
- Stay within 130-160 words (HARD LIMIT — this produces 50-60 second videos)
- End with a call to action
- Be formatted as a narration script (no stage directions)

Save the script for the video pipeline to pick up.

templates.name: Morning Video Pipeline
templates.description: Produce the morning video: voice generation, avatar, captions, QA, and publish.
templates.message:
Run the video production pipeline for the morning content slot (pillar slot 1).
Pick up the script from the daily queue.

Pipeline steps:
1. Generate voiceover (ElevenLabs)
2. Generate avatar video (HeyGen)
3. Burn captions if enabled
4. Run QA checks (duration, audio levels, visual quality)
5. Publish to configured platforms

Report results to the notification channel. If any step fails, report the error and stop — do not publish a broken video.

templates.name: Weekly Knowledge Research
templates.description: Research sprint to expand the knowledge base with fresh industry insights.
templates.message:
Run a knowledge research sprint.
Read the client profile for niche and industry context.

1. Research 3-5 trending topics in the client's industry
2. For each topic, extract key insights, data points, and actionable takeaways
3. Format as knowledge entries and save to the client knowledge base
4. Tag entries with relevant domains and agent targets
5. Post a summary of what was added to the notification channel

Focus on practical, actionable knowledge — not theoretical or generic content.

Review the CRM pipeline and generate a morning digest:

2. Deals that haven't been updated in 7+ days (stale)

5. Any meetings or calls scheduled today
Post the digest to the notification channel. Flag anything that needs immediate attention.

3. Verify knowledge search returns relevant results for 3 test queries
4. Report: entries total, duplicates found, entries flagged for review
Post summary to notification channel.

templates.name: Social Content Creator
templates.description: Generate today's social content based on content mix — text posts, image posts, or additional video topics. Platform-specific captions for each target platform.
templates.message:
You are generating social media content for today. Follow these steps exactly:

1. Read the content mix by running: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/client-policy.json — look at social.content_mix (video_reels %, text_posts %, image_posts %).
2. Read content pillars by running: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/content-pillars.json — get pillars array, rotation_epoch, and target_platforms.
3. Calculate today's pillar rotation based on rotation_epoch. Determine today's content type from the mix percentages using a rotation cycle.
4. Read the client profile from your system prompt for brand voice, niche, and target audience.

Generate platform-specific captions as a JSON object with keys matching target_platforms. Rules per platform:
- instagram: Up to 2200 chars, 5-10 hashtags from pillar's hashtags array, soft CTA
- x: Max 280 chars, conversational, no hashtags, punchy
- linkedin: Professional tone, industry terms, up to 3000 chars
- tiktok: Hook-first, quick value, #fyp + niche hashtags
- facebook: Engaging question, shareable, encourage comments

Generate a unique job_id in the format: social-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<pillar>-<type> (e.g. social-20260407-0700-ai-demos-text).

SAVE TO DATABASE (MANDATORY — do not save to JSON files):
Run this sqlite3 command to insert into the database:

sqlite3 "${CLIENT_ROOT:-/opt/AIWH/client}/data/video-jobs.db" "INSERT INTO video_jobs (job_id, topic, pillar, content_type, status, captions, platform_targets, source, script, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('<job_id>', '<topic>', '<pillar>', '<content_type>', 'pending_review', '<captions_json>', '<platform_targets_json>', 'social', '<image_prompt_if_image_post_else_empty>', datetime('now'), datetime('now'));"

Rules:
- content_type must be 'text_post' or 'image_post'
- captions must be valid JSON with platform keys (escape single quotes by doubling them)
- platform_targets must be a JSON array. IMPORTANT: Instagram and TikTok do NOT support text-only posts. For text_post, use only platforms that accept text: x, linkedin, facebook. For image_post or video_reel, use all target_platforms.
- status: check auto-publish settings first. Run: python3 -c "import json; p=json.load(open('${CLIENT_ROOT:-/opt/AIWH/client}/config/client-policy.json')); s=p.get('social',{}); ct='<content_type>'; auto=s.get('auto_publish_text',False) if ct=='text_post' else s.get('auto_publish_images',False); print('approved' if auto else 'pending_review')"
  If auto-publish is ON for this content type, use status='approved' (scheduler picks it up automatically).
  If auto-publish is OFF, use status='pending_review' (appears in dashboard Review tab for manual approval).

If today is an IMAGE POST day, also run after the DB insert:
bash /opt/AIWH/core/scripts/generate-social-image.sh --job-id <the_job_id>

Post a summary of what you created to the notification channel.

templates.name: Daily Social Post Scheduler
templates.description: Schedule approved content to social platforms via Buffer. Resolves platform format, uses per-platform captions, skips format mismatches.
templates.message:
You are scheduling today's social media posts. Follow these steps:

1. Read client config: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/client-policy.json — extract social section for max_posts_per_day and engagement_hours.
2. Read content pillars: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/content-pillars.json — extract target_platforms and platform_formats (hierarchical: platform → content_type → ratio).
3. Detect your social platform: run check-platform.sh social, then read the platform's SKILL.md.
4. Query approved items: sqlite3 ${CLIENT_ROOT:-/opt/AIWH/client}/data/video-jobs.db "SELECT job_id, content_type, captions, image_path, image_paths, platform_targets, captioned_video_path FROM video_jobs WHERE status='approved';"

For each approved item and each target platform:
- If VIDEO: check the video format vs platform_formats[platform].video_reel. If format matches, schedule it. If mismatch, SKIP.
- If TEXT POST: schedule to all target platforms using the platform-specific caption from the captions JSON.
- If IMAGE POST: read image_paths (JSON column, e.g. {"3:4":"/path/3x4.png","16:9":"/path/16x9.png"}). For each platform, get its required ratio from platform_formats[platform].image_post. Select the matching image path. If no matching ratio exists, skip that platform.
  IMPORTANT for Instagram image posts: use metadata {"instagram":{"type":"post","shouldShareToFeed":true}} — NOT "reel".

BEFORE scheduling, load secrets and check which Buffer channel IDs are actually configured:
  aiwh_load_secrets BUFFER_API_TOKEN BUFFER_IG_CHANNEL_ID BUFFER_X_CHANNEL_ID BUFFER_LINKEDIN_CHANNEL_ID BUFFER_FB_CHANNEL_ID
Only schedule to platforms that have a non-empty channel ID. Skip platforms without a channel ID and log: 'Skipped {platform} — no Buffer channel configured.'

max_posts_per_day is the limit of CONTENT PIECES (not platform slots). Posting 1 item to IG + X = 1 against the cap, not 2.

Set publish time within the engagement_hours window.
Update each item's status to 'scheduled' after successful scheduling.
Post a summary to the notification channel: what was scheduled, to which platforms, and any skipped items.

templates.name: Social Engagement Monitor
templates.description: Pull engagement data from Buffer, draft reply suggestions for top comments, send summary to notification channel.
templates.message:
You are monitoring social media engagement. Follow these steps:

1. Read client config by running: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/client-policy.json — check social section for notify_on_comments and engagement_hours. If outside engagement_hours, skip this run.
2. Detect your social platform: run check-platform.sh social, then read the platform's SKILL.md.
3. Pull recent analytics from the social platform — reach, engagement, clicks for posts from the last 24 hours.
4. Identify the top-performing post (highest engagement rate).
5. Extract the reply_tone from the client-policy.json you already read.
6. Draft 3-5 suggested replies for any notable comments or engagement patterns. Use the reply_tone as your voice guide. Be social — emojis are welcome.
7. Send a concise summary to the notification channel:
   - Posts active: X
   - Total reach: X
   - Top post: [title] — [engagement rate]
   - Suggested replies (if applicable)
   - New follower count (if available from platform)

Do NOT reply to comments directly — this requires direct platform API access. Only draft suggestions for the client to review.

templates.name: Weekly Social Strategy Review
templates.description: Analyze week's performance, compare to history, update hashtags, generate next week's content calendar, recommend strategy changes.
templates.message:
You are running the weekly social media strategy review. This is the core feedback loop — your analysis drives next week's content.

1. METRICS: Pull this week's performance from the social platform (check-platform.sh social → SKILL.md). Gather: total reach, engagement rate, follower growth, top 3 posts, worst performing post.

2. COMPARE: Read /opt/AIWH/client/data/social-metrics.json for historical data. Compare this week vs last week: reach trend, engagement trend, follower growth rate.

3. ANALYZE: Read social_grades from this week (if available). Which content types (video/text/image) got the best grades from the client? Which pillars performed best? Which platforms drove the most engagement?

4. HASHTAG REFRESH: Use opencli to research 10-15 trending hashtags in the client's niche (read niche from your system prompt). Update the hashtags arrays in content-pillars.json — keep existing high-performing tags, replace underperformers with trending ones.

5. CONTENT CALENDAR: Generate next week's content calendar based on:
   - Content mix from client-policy.json (run: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/client-policy.json)
   - Pillar rotation from content-pillars.json (run: cat /opt/AIWH/client/config/content-pillars.json)
   - Performance data (more of what works, less of what doesn't)
   - Platform format awareness (which pillars have 9:16 avatars for Instagram vs 16:9 for LinkedIn)

6. RECOMMENDATIONS: Generate 3-5 specific, data-backed recommendations:
   - Example: 'Increase Pillar X posting — 2x engagement vs other pillars'
   - Example: 'Post at 6pm instead of 2pm — reach is 40% higher in evening'
   - Example: 'Text posts outperform images on Tuesdays — shift mix'

7. SAVE: Write updated metrics to /opt/AIWH/client/data/social-metrics.json (append to weeks array, keep last 12 weeks). Include recommendations in the JSON.

8. NOTIFY: Check for stuck review items (pending_review > 24 hours). Send full strategy report to notification channel.

This report is the client's weekly social intelligence briefing. Make it actionable.

templates.name: Daily Cost Briefing
templates.description: CFO sends daily summary of API spending, budget status, and any cost anomalies to the notification channel.
templates.message:
Generate a concise daily cost briefing. Read:
1. /opt/AIWH/client/logs/cost-monitor.log — extract today's and yesterday's API spending.
2. /opt/AIWH/client/logs/spend-status.txt — current budget status (OK/WARN/CRITICAL).
3. /opt/AIWH/client/config/client-policy.json budget section — daily and monthly limits.

Calculate:
- Today's spend so far
- Yesterday's total spend
- Month-to-date total
- Percentage of monthly budget used
- Daily average this month
- Projected month-end spend at current rate

Flag any anomalies: spend spikes (>2x daily average), approaching budget limits (>80%), or unusual agent activity.

Send a brief, scannable summary to the notification channel. Use bullet points. Keep it under 15 lines. The client should know their cost position in 10 seconds.
